description: This file defines a custom view component 'SlidingTabLayout' which is used to provide a tab indicator integrated with a ViewPager, enabling users to navigate between pages with visual feedback. It supports customization of tab appearance, colors, and behavior.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom view extending HorizontalScrollView that displays tabs linked with a ViewPager, allowing for customizable tab indicators and appearance.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface to control the colors of the tab indicator and dividers dynamically based on position.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom implementation of TabColorizer to choose indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the selected tab indicator; supports a circular array of colors.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the divider lines between tabs.

methods.name: setOnPageChangeListener
methods.description: Sets an external page change listener to be notified of page scroll events.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Configures custom layout resources for tab views and their text components.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Associates a ViewPager with this tab layout to synchronize tab selection and display.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default styled TextView to serve as a tab if no custom layout is provided.
